definitionZh: stop-opacity CSS 属性定义了 SVG 梯度内 SVG 元素中给定的颜色梯度停止的不透明度. 如果存在,它会超越元素的属性.
sourceDefinition: The stop-opacity CSS property defines the opacity of a given color gradient stop in the SVG element within an SVG gradient. If present, it overrides the element's attribute.
